event_chain.summary: Privilege abuse - voter record accessed and leaked

summary: An electoral officer of Nigeria's Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) used valid Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) platform credentials to access and disclose, without authorization, the voter registration record of actor and politician Emeka Ike, which then circulated online during a party primary dispute in the Federal Capital Territory in mid-2026. INEC's audit trail identified the account and officer, who was suspended; INEC said there was no external hack. The case was referred to the DSS and police.
